json_patch.value: Fix: mcp: migrate the server to the 2.x MCP SDK. Target files: Dockerfile, mcp/README.md, mcp/openaccountants_mcp/server.py. Moves `openaccountants-mcp` from the 1.x `FastMCP` API to the 2.x `MCPServer` API and lifts the `mcp<2` cap, so #153 can close. (Ref: https://github.com/openaccountants/openaccountants/pull/174)
